name: Mark Cuban
rootCause: Mark Cuban, a billionaire entrepreneur and owner of the Dallas Mavericks, fell victim to a hack on September 16th. Altogether, he was set back by around $870,000 across 10 cryptocurrencies. He said he moved his remaining funds to Coinbase custody.
